no_drive: ❌ The Drive connection is not set up: the repository secrets DRIVE_URL and DRIVE_KEY are missing.
retry_client: 🔁 YouTube blocked the {prev} client. Retrying with {next}...
cookies_used: 🍪 Using cookies from the YT_COOKIES secret.
cookies_logged_in: ✅ The cookies include a signed-in account.
cookies_bad_format: ❌ The cookies are not in the right format. Export them with the "Get cookies.txt LOCALLY" extension (Netscape format).
cookies_not_logged_in: ❌ The cookies have no signed-in account (LOGIN_INFO and SAPISID are missing), so YouTube ignores them. Export again from youtube.com while signed in.
hint_bot: 💡 YouTube is blocking GitHub's server. Save the contents of cookies.txt as a repository secret named YT_COOKIES and run again.
hint_update: 💡 yt-dlp may be outdated. Run again (every run installs the latest version).
upload_exists: ⏭️ Already in Drive (same name and size), not uploading again: {name}
drive_bad_key: DRIVE_KEY does not match the key in the Apps Script.
drive_no_token: The Apps Script returned no access token. Check that it is deployed as a Web app with access for Anyone.
drive_http_403: Google Drive refused (403). The Drive may be full, or the Apps Script is missing a permission.
drive_token_request: Could not reach the Apps Script address. Check that DRIVE_URL is the full Web app URL, starting with https://script.google.com/macros/s/ and ending with /exec.
